28:2.text: These are verses of the clear Book.

28:3.text: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.

28:4.text: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their
sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
